content.title: 10 best massage spots in JB to melt your stress away
content.text: Taking care of yourself isn’t just about eating well or keeping up with your workout routine. True self-care means finding the perfect balance between discipline and indulgence. Sometimes, a little pampering is exactly what you need to elevate your well-being.While regular exercise is essential for staying fit, let’s face it — those gym (or home!) sessions can take a toll on your body. That’s where a rejuvenating body massage comes in, offering both relaxation and recovery.Johor Bahru is a city brimming with such relaxing services that cater to both locals and Singaporeans crossing the border for a quick getaway. If you’re planning a visit, I’ve curated a list of the best massage spots in town to help you unwind and make the most of your trip!NameBest forLocation / AreaKey highlightBangkok SpaTravellers entering via JB CIQ who want convenient Thai massageJohor Bahru (Taman Pelangi, Taman Sri Tebrau, Taman Sentosa)Authentic Thai therapists and complimentary two-way transportThai OdysseyVisitors seeking a reputable spa chain with structured treatmentsMultiple outlets in Johor BahruLarge Thai spa brand with award-winning services and varied packagesSiam OasisThose wanting reflexology with multiple treatment optionsJohor Bahru (multiple locations)Wide menu of therapies including aromatherapy and reflexologyFamily Thai SpaGuests seeking a traditional Thai massage experience with varied therapiesJohor Bahru (multiple outlets)Over 80 therapists and services like gua sha, ear candling and full body massage38°c Onsen SpaCouples or groups wanting a spa session with a unique experienceMount Austin, Bandar Dato OnnOnsen soak with kimono experience and massage packageY Spa & WellnessVisitors interested in herbal wellness therapiesTaman PonderosaHerbal spa treatments using Chinese herbal ingredientsCrystal Leaf Beauty SpaGuests combining massage with beauty or facial treatmentsTaman CenturyBroad selection of massages, facials and pregnancy massageWhite Wood Spa & WellnessPeople seeking targeted relief for muscle tension or detox treatmentsIskandar PuteriMeridian deep tissue and lymphatic detox massage therapiesThong Yee ThongBudget-conscious visitors wanting established massage therapyTaman PelangiLong-running massage centre known for value-for-money treatmentsBangkok Family SpaVisitors wanting a classic Thai massage with extra spa facilitiesPermas Jaya, MasaiTraditional Thai massage alongside sauna, Jacuzzi and steam options1. Bangkok SpaCredit – Bangkok SpaBangkok Spa is a popular haven for authentic Thai massages, especially among Singaporeans. Its optimal location being near the JB CIQ makes it incredibly convenient, and they even provide complimentary 2-way transportation for their guests. With a team of over a hundred professionally-trained masseurs from Thailand, Bangkok Spa guarantees a top-notch experience every time you visit.Credit – Bangkok SpaBangkok Spa offers 3 main services to elevate your relaxation:Foot Massage This therapy focuses on stimulating pressure points in the feet, promoting stress relief, improved circulation, and overall balance. Choose from 2 sessions: RM66 for 60 minutes or RM99 for 90 minutes.Traditional Thai Massage A holistic healing technique that harmonises mind and body. Performed on a floor mattress, the therapist uses a combination of thumb, hand, foot, arm, and leg pressure, along with gentle stretches to ease tension, improve flexibility, and leave you deeply relaxed. Sessions are available at RM66 for 60 minutes, RM99 for 90 minutes, RM132 for 120 minutes, or RM165 for 150 minutes.Aromatherapy Thai Massage Designed to manage pain, alleviate stress, and uplift your overall well-being, this massage uses soothing strokes and essential oils to penetrate the skin and promote lymphatic drainage. Options include RM90 for 60 minutes, RM135 for 90 minutes, RM180 for 120 minutes, or RM225 for 150 minutes.Taman Pelangi Branch No 58, 58A, 58B, 60, 60A, 60B, 62, 62A, 62B, Jalan Abiad, Taman Tebrau Jaya, 80400, Johor Bahru, Johor +6017-338 2277 Daily: 11am – 5amTaman Sri Tebrau Branch No 171, 171A, 173, 173A, 175A, Jalan Perisai, Taman Sri Tebrau, 80050, Johor Bahru, Johor +6017-338 2233 Daily: 11am – 5amTaman Sentosa Branch No 159, 161, Jalan Sutera, Taman Sentosa, 80150, Johor Bahru, Johor +6018-323 2277 Daily: 11am – 5am Facebook | Instagram | Website2. Thai OdysseyCredit – Thai OdysseyAs Malaysia’s largest Thai massage and spa chain, Thai Odyssey boasts over 45 outlets nationwide, including 7 in Johor Bahru. Known for its award-winning services, this spa welcomes guests aged 16 and above to experience a variety of treatments, from a simple body scrub to an immersive full-body massage.Credit – Thai OdysseySome of the services offered are:Thai Traditional Massage (RM140 for 60 minutes, RM169 for 90 minutes, RM219 for 120 minutes) This oil-free massage incorporates acupressure, joint mobilization, deep muscle compression, and yoga-inspired stretches to unblock energy, enhance flexibility, reduce fatigue, and improve sleep. Let the skilled therapists ease your mind and body into bliss, all while dressed in comfortable massage attire.Thai Herbal Therapy (RM249 for 120 minutes) Experience the soothing warmth of a heated herbal poultice filled with ingredients like lemongrass, turmeric, and kaffir lime. This therapeutic treatment relieves sore muscles, improves circulation, and reduces water retention, making it ideal for postpartum recovery or deep relaxation.Gentle Palm Massage (RM249 for 90 minutes) For those who prefer a gentler approach, this treatment uses long, light kneading strokes and pure oils like Jojoba. Perfect for customers who prefer side-lying or seated positions, this massage avoids pressure on the tummy area.Body Scrub (RM199 for 60 minutes) Revive your skin with aromatic, moisturising scrubs that slough away dryness, leaving it soft, supple, and radiant. This luxurious treatment rejuvenates both body and mind.Ultimate Thai Odyssey (RM469 for single, RM888 for couple) Indulge in a luxurious 3-hour signature treatment in complete privacy. Begin with a refreshing foot bath and full-body exfoliation, followed by a relaxing milk bath, and conclude with a soothing aromatherapy massage for the ultimate pampering experience.For a list of locations, opening hours, and contact numbers, click here.Facebook | Instagram | Website3. Siam OasisSiam Oasis, proudly recognised by the Malaysian Book of Records for launching the most reflexology wellness outlets post-MCO, boasts 8 locations in Johor Bahru alone. Blending the timeless art of Thai reflexology with cutting-edge wellness technology, it offers an array of services designed to elevate your relaxation experience.At Siam Oasis, you can choose from an array of à la carte packages tailored to your needs. The Premium Sacha Inchi Aromatherapy is available at RM168 for 60 minutes, RM203 for 90 minutes, and RM233 for 120 minutes, with additional Premium Sacha Inchi Beauty Oil priced at RM35 per bottle. The Back Healing Therapy is offered at RM108 for 30 minutes and RM176 for 60 minutes, while the Royal Thai Therapy is available at RM136 for 60 minutes, RM156 for 90 minutes, and RM186 for 120 minutes. For those seeking a luxurious aromatherapy experience, the Royal Aromatherapy is priced at RM156 for 60 minutes, RM196 for 90 minutes, and RM226 for 120 minutes, with an optional additional aromatherapy oil for RM18 per bottle.The 5 Senses Therapy, which includes head, shoulder, back, foot, and foot soak, is available at RM103 for 60 minutes and RM168 for 90 minutes. Additionally, the 936 LAE Therapy, priced at RM110 for 60 minutes, comes with complimentary LAE Active Water Therapy.For regular visitors, Siam Oasis offers convenient 6-month packages, including the Back Healing Therapy for RM648 and the Royal Thai Therapy for RM816.For info on their locations, opening hours, and contact numbers, click here.Facebook | Instagram | Website4. Family Thai SpaWith over 80 professional Chinese-Thai massage therapists, Family Thai Spa is another excellent choice for your next relaxing massage session. Renowned for delivering the most authentic Thai massage experience, each Johor Bahru outlet offers a unique theme, ensuring a fresh and exciting visit every time. The cosy ambiance, coupled with exceptional service, makes it a true haven for relaxation.Family Thai Spa offers a range of therapeutic services designed to rejuvenate your body and mind:Gua Sha (RM48) This traditional technique aids in removing blood stasis, reducing swelling, and relieving pain. Professional Ear Cleaning (RM69) Enjoy a thorough cleaning that removes earwax, clears pores, and promotes blood circulation in the ear area. It also refreshes the mind and enhances eyesight.American Ear Candling (RM78) This soothing therapy stimulates the central nervous system, particularly the brain, while improving lymph circulation. It’s also effective in relieving ear infections, sinusitis, pain, fever, ruptured eardrums, and dizziness.Full Body Massage (RM100 for 1 hour) Proven to boost cortisone levels, reduce blood pressure, and enhance serotonin and dopamine levels, this massage promotes relaxation and overall well-being.Click here to find more information on the list of outlets, opening hours, and contact numbers.Instagram | Website5. 38°c Onsen SpaCredit – 38°c Onsen SpaNestled in Mount Austin and Bandar Dato Onn, 38°C Onsen Spa offers a holistic full-body relaxation experience, combining the serenity of a rejuvenating onsen soak, a kimono fitting, and a soothing massage.Begin your journey with a Kimono Experience, where you can don a traditional kimono and capture cherished memories with your loved ones. Next, immerse yourself in the soothing 38°C mineral-rich onsen waters, expertly crafted to melt away stress and leave you feeling refreshed and revitalized. Enhance your experience with a platter of delightful desserts to complement your relaxation. Conclude your session with a rejuvenating Full Body Massage, restoring balance and vitality to your body and mind.This comprehensive 2-hour 30-minute package is priced at RM398 for one person, RM599 for two, and RM896 for three.Mount Austin Branch Akademik Suite, Block A #G, 05, Jalan Austin Heights Utama, Taman Mount Austin, 81100 Johor Bahru, Johor Darul Ta’zim +6011-7019 7499 Daily: 10.30am – 9pmDato Onn Branch 15-01, Jln Perjiranan 4/6, Bandar Dato Onn, 81750 Johor Bahru, Johor Darul Ta’zim +6014-353 8223 Daily: 10am – 9pm Facebook | Instagram | Website6. Y Spa & WellnessY Spa & Wellness, proudly recognised as Malaysia’s first herbal spa by the Malaysian Book of Records, is a tranquil sanctuary nestled in Taman Ponderosa. This serene retreat offers a range of rejuvenating services, from herbal massages to expertly crafted body treatments, all designed to restore balance and vitality.The Signature Spa features the Herbal Spa (RM169), a therapeutic bath infused with 38 Chinese herbal ingredients. Harnessing the heat of the water and the skin’s natural absorption, this treatment delivers the herbs’ restorative properties for overall wellness. For a more luxurious experience, the Imperial Herbal Spa (RM199) enhances this ritual with premium-quality herbs for deeper rejuvenation.Body Treatments include the Deep Tissue Body Massage (RM169), which blends traditional Malay techniques with a unique herbal oil formula to ease muscle tension. The Hot Stone Massage Therapy (RM199) combines heated stones with soothing massage strokes to relieve tension and improve circulation. For specialised care, the Uterus Care Therapy (RM229) integrates traditional massage methods with Chinese herbal remedies to support uterine and ovarian health, administered by skilled therapists.35, Jalan Ponderosa 2/2, Taman Ponderosa, 81100 Johor Bahru, Johor Darul Ta’zim +6018-790 3888 Daily: 10am – 7.30pm Facebook | Instagram7. Crystal Leaf Beauty SpaCredit – Crystal Leaf Beauty SpaFor those seeking body massages that enhance both relaxation and physical aesthetics, Crystal Leaf Beauty Spa offers an extensive selection of packages designed to rejuvenate your body and provide a subtle glow-up.Credit – Crystal Leaf Beauty SpaFor full-body renewal, the Crystal Leaf Signature Massage masterfully combines traditional Malay techniques to stimulate blood circulation, ease stress, and relax muscles, leaving you deeply revitalised. This indulgent treatment is available in 60, 90, and 120-minute sessions. For a softer, more calming touch, the Aromatherapy Massage soothes the senses with gentle strokes that calm the heart, reduce stress, and lower blood pressure. Meanwhile, the Swedish Massage provides a firmer, targeted approach to relieve muscle tension, enhance relaxation, and improve circulation. Both treatments are offered in 60, 90, and 120-minute durations to suit your needs.Elevating self-care further, Crystal Leaf Beauty Spa offers luxurious facial treatments tailored to enhance your natural beauty and restore a luminous complexion. Choose from the Eye Collagen Treatment, the refreshing Express Facial, or the comprehensive Crystal Leaf Facial with Extraction. For more advanced skincare, indulge in the Dermaplaning Treatment, Glow Treatment, Anti-Ageing Facial, or Lifting & Firming Facial. Expectant mothers can find comfort in the spa’s nurturing Pregnancy Massage, available in 90 and 120-minute sessions. This safe and gentle therapy is thoughtfully designed to relieve common pregnancy discomforts, offering relaxation and a profound sense of well-being throughout your journey.109, Jalan Dato Sulaiman, Taman Century, 80250 Johor Bahru, Johor Darul Ta’zim +6012-778 9139 Daily: 11am – 11pm Facebook | Instagram | Website8. White Wood Spa & WellnessCredit – White Wood Spa & WellnessWhite Wood Spa & Wellness is renowned for its exceptional Thai and meridian massage therapies, thoughtfully designed to promote relaxation, rejuvenation, and overall well-being. Over the years, they have steadily earned the trust and loyalty of their patrons. Credit – White Wood Spa & WellnessBegin your journey with a calming Foot Reflexology & Herbal Footbath, where a soothing blend of aromatic herbs and warm water stimulates circulation and prepares your feet for reflexology. This treatment is available in 60-minute sessions for RM88 or 90-minute sessions for RM128. For targeted relief, the Back & Shoulder Massage focuses on easing tension in stress-prone areas — perfect for those who spend long hours sitting or standing. Choose from 30 minutes for RM68 or 45 minutes for RM88.For a deeper sense of renewal, the Lymphatic Massage (Detox) stimulates the lymphatic system to flush out toxins and reduce excess fluids, promoting a lighter, more energised body. This detoxifying therapy is offered in 60 minutes for RM138, 90 minutes for RM188, or 120 minutes for RM238. Those struggling with chronic aches or muscle stiffness can find relief in the Meridian Deep Tissue Massage, which targets deeper muscle layers to release persistent tension and restore mobility. This intensive treatment is available in 60 minutes for RM118, 90 minutes for RM158, or 120 minutes for RM198.3, Jalan Eko Botani 3/7, Taman, Persiaran Eko Botani, 79100 Iskandar Puteri, Johor Darul Ta’zim +6019-232 9880 Daily: 11am – 1am Facebook | Instagram | Website9. Thong Yee ThongThong Yee Thong stands as one of Johor Bahru’s oldest and most established health massage centres, proudly serving clients since the 1990s. While reviews may vary, its reputation for offering excellent value for money makes it a must-visit destination for quality massage therapy in JB.At Thong Yee Thong, guests can unwind with a variety of Foot, Shoulder, Body, and Herbal Massage packages. The Foot Massage is a crowd favourite, where skilled therapists apply precise acupressure to targeted points on the feet, effectively relieving stress and enhancing blood circulation. This treatment is available in 60 minutes for RM60, 80 minutes for RM72, 100 minutes for RM92, and 120 minutes for RM108.For a more thorough experience, the Foot and Shoulder Massage offers a harmonious blend of foot reflexology and a relaxing shoulder massage. Choose from 40 minutes + 20 minutes for RM65, 60 minutes + 30 minutes for RM92, or 80 minutes + 40 minutes for RM117. As an added bonus, treatments lasting 90 minutes or more include a complimentary Fire Cupping or Scraping Therapy upon request.For female guests, please note that the masseuse will thoroughly massage the upper body. If you prefer adjustments to this, kindly inform the therapist to ensure a comfortable experience.69a, 69b, 71, 73, 75, Jalan Kuning, Taman Pelangi, 80400 Johor Bahru, Johor Darul Ta’zim +6016-722 5811 Daily: 10am – 1am Facebook | Instagram | Website10. Bangkok Family SpaCreditBangkok Family Spa is a beloved retreat for locals and tourists seeking an authentic Thai massage experience. Designed to transport you to Thailand, the spa blends culture and relaxation seamlessly.Credit – Bangkok Family SpaThe Traditional Thai Massage harmonises mind and body through skilled pressure techniques using the masseuse’s hands, feet, and body weight to stretch the spine and release tension. This full-body treatment, moving from feet to head, is available in 60-minute (RM 66), 90-minute (RM 99), 120-minute (RM 132), and 180-minute (RM 198) sessions. Credit – Bangkok Family SpaFor a gentler experience, the Aromatherapy Massage combines soothing strokes with essential oils that ease pain, reduce stress, and promote well-being. Sessions are offered for 60 minutes (RM 90), 90 minutes (RM 135), 120 minutes (RM 180), and 180 minutes (RM 270).The spa also offers sauna, Jacuzzi, and steam treatments, using heat therapy to relax muscles, relieve tension, and support healing — continuing a tradition dating back to ancient Rome.33-01, 33-02, 33-03, 35-01, 35-02, 35, 03, Jalan Permas 10/7, Bandar Baru Permas Jaya, 81750 Masai, Johor Darul Ta’zim +6011-1081 5555 Daily: 11am – 3am Facebook | Instagram | WebsitePeople also read:Where should you go for your next hair appointment in Johor Bahru?Where to find the best nail salons in JB?The post 10 best massage spots in JB to melt your stress away appeared first on SETHLUI.com.
